items.title: Retrieval-Augmented Generation and Parameter-Efficient Fine-Tuning for Financial Question Answering: Evidence from the FinQA Benchmark
items.claim: Retrieval augmentation lifted a 4-billion-parameter financial QA model from 17.2% to 64.4% exact match, matching parameter-efficient fine-tuning at 63.9%.

items.title: Governed Self-Evolution for Autonomous Investing: A Multi-Agent LLM System with an Invariant Core
items.claim: A protected invariant core cut a 24.6% sector drawdown to 0.3% and lowered maximum drawdown under all 50 random entry policies.

items.title: When News Gets Old: Portfolio Allocation with Reinforcement Learning and Large Language Models
items.claim: Filtering old news yielded 18.43% annual net returns for LLM portfolios with four-week delays, beating all news-using RL strategies.

items.title: Intraday Forecasting Ability and Liquidity Provision of Institutional Traders
items.claim: One passive execution raised intraday P&L by 1.28 currency units versus none, exceeding the 1.19-unit gain from a one-standard-deviation forecasting increase.

items.title: Headline Emphasis and Stock Returns: Evidence from Counterfactual Headlines
items.claim: A one-standard-deviation rise in headline divergence predicts nine basis points higher next-month returns through initial overreaction and later correction.

items.title: The Common Advice: Evidence on AI Redundancy in Stock Prices
items.claim: After ChatGPT, common AI signals still forecast positive earnings announcement returns, indicating market underreaction rather than AI-driven overreaction.
